name: denaneya-monorepo
description: দেনা নেয়া ভার্সন টু (DenaNeya v2.0) - Hardened MFS Payment Automation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "api,dashboard,web" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run --workspace=packages/shared build && npm run --workspace=packages/database build
scripts.build:apps: npm run --workspace=apps/api build && npm run --workspace=apps/dashboard build && npm run --workspace=apps/web build
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:database
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/dashboard/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/dist apps/*/node_modules apps/*/dist apps/*/.next dist
